name: carbon-arc
description: Carbon Arc plugins for competitive, consumer, audience and place intelligence.

plugins.name: carbon-arc-company-intelligence
plugins.description: Three reports, using Carbon Arc data. An insights report for a company's strategy team: where its customers also spend, whether a move is the company or the category, which customers it is losing, what an event did, and who is winning. A pre-print earnings preview of a listed consumer company's quarter, validated against its reported history. And a category and market report for a small or regional business.

plugins.name: carbon-arc-talent-intelligence
plugins.description: Audience intelligence for talent management, agencies and labels: who an artist really competes with, whether their audience is growing against those peers, who the audience is, which brand partnerships are distinctively theirs, resale demand, and for actors the work itself.

plugins.name: carbon-arc-location-intelligence
plugins.description: Two reports, using Carbon Arc data. A place report: how a metro area's economy is doing against comparable metro areas, or what a dated shock such as a storm or a plant closure did to it, read from two sides: what the people who live there spend and on what, and what happens at its locations. And a venue report: how an arena, stadium or theater's ticket market is doing against comparable venues, which shows and games drive it, and what its events do to the blocks around it.
